recognize_zh: 中倍骨髓切片細胞密度極高，以顆粒球系增生為主，其間散在多群淡粉紅色、細胞質豐富且帶纖維紋理的大型組織球，即假性高雪氏細胞；配合 BCR::ABL1 陽性，符合 CML。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow with no residual fat in this field
Granulocytic hyperplasia with numerous myeloid precursors and maturing forms
Clusters of large histiocytes with abundant pink fibrillary cytoplasm (pseudo-Gaucher cells)
Mildly fibrotic streaming stroma at the right edge of the core
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with granulocytic hyperplasia composed of myeloid precursors and maturing granulocytes. Scattered throughout are clusters of large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic fibrillary cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei. Blasts are not evidently increased at this magnification, and a CD34 immunostain would help assess blast percentage. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia with pseudo-Gaucher cells, supported by the positive BCR::ABL1 FISH.

ddx.vs: Gaucher disease lacks the granulocytic hyperplasia and BCR::ABL1 fusion and is confirmed by low glucocerebrosidase activity.
These may be hypercellular with granulocytic predominance but show dysgranulopoiesis or monocytosis and are BCR::ABL1-negative.
Leukemoid reactions lack BCR::ABL1, small hypolobated megakaryocytes and basophilia.
